# proxmox_acme_plugin (Resource)

Manages an ACME DNS challenge plugin through `/cluster/acme/plugins`. The `data` map is sent to Proxmox base64-encoded and holds the DNS API credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_acme_challenge_schema" "dns" {
  type = "dns"
}

resource "proxmox_acme_plugin" "cloudflare" {
  plugin = "cloudflare"
  type   = "dns"
  api    = "cf"
  data = {
    CF_API_TOKEN = var.cloudflare_token
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plugin` (String) Unique plugin id. Changes require replacement.
- `type` (String) Challenge type, for example `dns`. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `api` (String) DNS API implementation, for example `aws` or `cloudflare`.
- `data` (Map of String, Sensitive) DNS API credentials and options.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this plugin.
- `nodes` (Set of String) Nodes the plugin may be used on. Unset means all nodes.
- `validation_delay` (Number) Seconds to wait for DNS propagation before validation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Plugin id.
